message.reasoning_content:
We need to identify crimes based on facts. Facts: group attacked a school security guard, cut him (砍伤) => causing injury. That's intentional injury (故意伤害). Also they helped the perpetrators escape, i.e., aiding and abetting (帮助逃跑) maybe "帮助犯罪" or "包庇罪"? In Chinese criminal law, aiding a criminal after a crime is "帮助犯罪分子逃跑罪" (帮助犯罪分子逃跑罪) under Article 110 of Criminal Law: "帮助犯罪分子逃跑、隐匿、转移、变卖、毁灭犯罪工具、犯罪所得的，处三年以下有期徒刑、拘役或者管制，并处或者单处罚金；情节严重的，处三年以上七年以下有期徒刑。" So they helped escape. Also they provided shelter (藏匿) => also "窝藏" (窝藏罪). Actually "窝藏" is also under same article: "窝藏、包庇犯罪分子" is also a crime. So they could be charged with "帮助犯罪分子逃跑罪" or "窝藏罪". The facts: they helped the attackers escape, transported them, and later helped hide them in a village. So likely crimes: "故意伤害罪" for the assault on the guard; "帮助犯罪分子逃跑罪" (or "帮助逃跑罪") and "窝藏罪". In Chinese law, "帮助犯罪分子逃跑" and "窝藏" are separate offenses but both under Article 110. The question: "只写这部分事实直接支持的罪名". The facts support: intentional injury (故意伤害) and "帮助犯罪分子逃跑" (帮助逃跑) and "窝藏". Could also be "聚众斗殴"? No, they used knives. So main crimes: 故意伤害;帮助犯罪分子逃跑;窝藏. Use semicolons.

Thus answer: [罪名]故意伤害;帮助犯罪分子逃跑;窝藏<eoa>
